## NYT::NFlow::TKafkaClientConfig {#NYT_NFlow_TKafkaClientConfig}
<!-- This file is generated by yt/yt/flow/yandex/tools/generate_yson_struct_doc/generate.sh script -->
<!-- Before using doc generation tool check readme: yt/yt/flow/yandex/tools/generate_yson_struct_doc/README.md -->
Source: [yt/yt/flow/extensions/kafka/kafka_client.h]({{source-root}}/yt/yt/flow/extensions/kafka/kafka_client.h)

Connection and authentication settings of the Kafka client resource `NYT::NFlow::TKafkaClient`. Kafka sources and sinks use the resource with the ID `KafkaClient`.

#|
|| **Parameter** | **Description** ||
|| `bootstrap_servers` | **Type**: `std::string`
**Required parameter**
Comma-separated list of Kafka brokers, passed to librdkafka as `bootstrap.servers`. ||
|| `cluster_name` | **Type**: `std::string`
**Default value**: `TString("")`
Stable name of the Kafka cluster. The partition keys of Kafka sources, and so the offsets the pipeline persists, are derived from it, so set it before the broker list changes. When it is empty, the keys are derived from `bootstrap_servers`; setting it to the current value of `bootstrap_servers` keeps the keys of a running pipeline. ||
|| `security_protocol` | **Type**: `std::string`
**Default value**: `PLAINTEXT`
librdkafka `security.protocol`: `PLAINTEXT`, `SSL`, `SASL_PLAINTEXT`, or `SASL_SSL`. ||
|| `sasl_mechanism` | **Type**: `std::string`
**Default value**: `TString("")`
librdkafka `sasl.mechanism`, for example `PLAIN`, `SCRAM-SHA-256`, or `SCRAM-SHA-512`. ||
|| `sasl_username` | **Type**: `std::string`
**Default value**: `TString("")`
librdkafka `sasl.username`. ||
|| `sasl_password_env` | **Type**: `std::string`
**Default value**: `KAFKA_SASL_PASSWORD`
Name of the environment variable of the controller and worker processes that holds the SASL password. The password itself is never stored in the spec. ||
|| `ssl_ca_location` | **Type**: `std::string`
**Default value**: `TString("")`
librdkafka `ssl.ca.location`: path to the CA certificate bundle for TLS. ||
|| `extra_config` | **Type**: `THashMap<std::string, std::string>`
**Default value**: `{}`
Additional librdkafka properties applied to every Kafka consumer and producer of the pipeline, for example `partitioner` or `compression.type`. Properties the connector manages itself, such as `group.id`, `enable.idempotence`, or `bootstrap.servers`, are rejected. ||
|#
